messages:
Claire (Finance): Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem. Late ingestion + dedupe regression produced an accidental token bump. A subset of usage invoices may be affected. Need owners for invoice hold, canonical list, verification, comms, and final credit posting.
Ben (Billing Eng): I can take verification and credit staging. Plan: run a bounded reconcile, stage credits to a review ledger with flag `review_pending`, and expose a small verification dashboard.
Ravi (SRE): I'll own containment + replay orchestration. Immediate actions: pause the partner connector, snapshot ledger watermark, run a dry-run replay in staging with dedupe keys enforced.
Ava (Customer Success): I'll draft comms templates and coordinate high-touch outreach for top-impact customers. Legal review needed before sending anything.
Sam (RevOps): I'll handle invoice tagging and hold on autopay. Suggest tag `metering-correction-3301`. Will also coordinate with collections.
notif-bot: Incident 7610 created by Ravi. Checklist: pause-source, staging-replay, delta-table, staged-credits, comms-draft, invoice-tagging. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/7610
Claire (Finance): Timelines: canonical affected list in 24h, staging verification in 48h, provisional credits staged within 7 business days, final posting within 12 business days after verification. Any blockers?
Ben (Billing Eng): 7/12 business days OK if dry-run passes. I'll run manual spot checks for top 20 accounts before posting.
Ravi (SRE): Dry-run scheduled for 2026-06-17T02:00Z. I'll add an alert `late_ingest_pct` and auto-pause rule if >0.4% over 2h.
Ava (Customer Success): Drafting comms now; will upload for Legal review in ticket 7610/docs.
Sam (RevOps): Invoice tagging ready on staging; promote to prod after 4h smoke test. Will block dunning for tagged invoices.
Claire (Finance): Please add checklist items to 7610 and set owner + ETA. We'll do a 20m gate review tomorrow 09:30 PT before any production posting. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
